LanguageData.PGM_RefreshInterval_Tip: How often the cached power snapshot is rebuilt while the map is active. This setting does not change the game's power simulation.
LanguageData.PGM_HistoryEnabled_Tip: When enabled, aggregate generation, consumption and battery energy are sampled at the interval below and stored in the save. Turning this off stops recording but keeps existing history.
LanguageData.PGM_SampleInterval_Tip: How often one aggregate history sample is stored. One in-game hour is 2,500 ticks. Shorter intervals give smoother charts and use more save space.
LanguageData.PGM_Retention_Tip: Samples older than this many in-game days are discarded. History storage is bounded by this window.
LanguageData.PGM_HighLoad_Tip: Networks whose consumption reaches this share of their current generation are labelled High Load. This compares against current output, not installed capacity.
LanguageData.PGM_HighConsumption_Tip: Buildings drawing at least this much power are flagged in the building table. This is a display filter only.
LanguageData.PGM_Window_NoComponent: The power monitoring component is not available on this map yet.
LanguageData.PGM_Window_Waiting: Waiting for the first power reading. Data refreshes on the next game tick.
LanguageData.PGM_Tab_OverviewTip: Map-wide generation, consumption, storage and data quality.
LanguageData.PGM_Tab_NetworksTip: Each connected power network with its own statistics.
LanguageData.PGM_Tab_BuildingsTip: Search, sort and filter every powered building.
LanguageData.PGM_Tab_HistoryTip: Recorded generation, consumption, net balance and battery charge over in-game time.
LanguageData.PGM_Overview_Notes: Generation and consumption are the current reported output of connected power traders that are switched on right now: {0} and {1} respectively. Installed generation capacity is not shown because a generator's configured output is not a reliable ceiling for every generator type. Battery energy is reported in watt-days (power multiplied by time), which the game also uses for stored energy. Nominal draw is the configured consumption from building definitions and is listed separately from measured draw. Data notices count unsupported components, pending network membership and consumers without a network.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_LoadRatio: Current consumption divided by current generation. Above 100% means batteries are covering the difference or demand is going unmet. Unknown when nothing is generating.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_HighLoadNetworks: Networks whose consumption reaches the configured high-load share of their current generation. Change the threshold in the mod settings.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_Unsupported: Power components that are not a recognised type. Their electrical behavior is not interpreted or counted in any total.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_SwitchedOff: Buildings with a flick switch that is currently off. They draw no power, so their measured draw is zero while their nominal draw is retained.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_CurrentGeneration: Sum of positive reported output from switched-on traders that are confirmed members of a power network. This is measured current production, not installed capacity.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_CurrentConsumption: Sum of negative reported output from switched-on traders that are confirmed members of a power network. Buildings that are switched off or unconnected contribute nothing here.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_NetBalance: Generation minus consumption. It excludes battery charging losses, battery self-discharge and debug unlimited-power effects, so it is a trader balance rather than a promise about stored energy.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_ConfiguredGeneration: Sum of the generation configured in generator definitions. This is a configuration figure from the buildings themselves, not a measurement and not a guarantee: variable-output generators regularly produce less than this.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_StoredEnergy: Physical battery energy in watt-days, summed across batteries on all networks, including batteries temporarily disabled by EMP.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_StorageCapacity: Configured maximum storage in watt-days. It does not guarantee that every battery is currently usable.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_Charge: Stored energy divided by configured capacity. Unknown when there are no batteries.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_Networks: Number of simulated power networks on this map, including networks with no generation.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_Consumers: Power components that currently request power and are confirmed network members. One building with several components can contribute more than once.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_Generators: Power components that currently produce or are configured to produce power and are confirmed network members.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_DeficitNetworks: Networks whose current consumption exceeds current generation. Batteries may still be covering the difference.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_DataNotices: Monitoring notices backed by observed data: unsupported power components, network membership that could not be confirmed, and consumers with no network. One building can raise more than one notice, so this is a notice count rather than a building count. Diagnostic advisories are a later feature.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_NominalDraw: Configured consumption from building definitions, for comparison with measured draw. Hidden when any consumer does not expose a usable configured value.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_Disconnected: Buildings with a power consumer that has no network assignment and no network membership. A momentary topology change can look like this for one refresh.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_Sampling: Interval used for the history samples stored in the save. Change it in the mod settings.
LanguageData.PGM_Networks_Empty: This map has no power networks yet.
LanguageData.PGM_Networks_SelectPrompt: Select a network on the left to see its details.
LanguageData.PGM_Networks_Incomplete: Some data for this network could not be confirmed, so its totals may be incomplete.
LanguageData.PGM_Networks_NoConsumers: No connected consumer on this network is currently drawing power.
LanguageData.PGM_Networks_RowTip: Generation {0}, consumption {1}. {2} consumers, {3} generators, {4} batteries. Click for details.
LanguageData.PGM_Networks_LocateTip: Jump to the network's largest consumer. This jumps to a building that is confirmed to be on the network; it does not draw the network itself.
LanguageData.PGM_Networks_ShowBuildingsTip: Open the building table filtered to this network.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_HistoryPerBuilding: Per-building history is not recorded. Only map-wide aggregates are sampled, so per-building historical averages and daily energy figures cannot be shown as measurements; the daily energy figure shown here is an estimate from the current draw.
LanguageData.PGM_Detail_SelectionMissing: This building is no longer part of the current power reading. It may have been destroyed, uninstalled or moved.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_EstDailyEnergy: Estimate only: the current measured draw multiplied by one in-game day, assuming the draw stays constant. Real demand varies, so treat this as a comparison figure rather than a measurement.
LanguageData.PGM_Buildings_SearchTip: Search by building name, definition name or category.
LanguageData.PGM_Buildings_NoPowerBuildings: No building on this map has a power component.
LanguageData.PGM_Buildings_NoMatches: No building matches the current search and filters.
LanguageData.PGM_Support_SupportedTip: Uses the game's standard power components, so its readings can be trusted.
LanguageData.PGM_Support_CustomTip: Power components come from another mod. They follow the standard power contract, but their custom overrides are not independently verified.
LanguageData.PGM_Support_PendingTip: Network membership could not be confirmed for this refresh. Totals exclude the building until it is confirmed.
LanguageData.PGM_Support_UnsupportedTip: At least one power component is not a recognised type, so its electrical behavior is not interpreted or counted.
LanguageData.PGM_History_Disabled: History recording is turned off. Enable it in the mod settings to collect samples.
LanguageData.PGM_History_Empty: No history samples yet. A sample is stored every {0} of in-game time while the map is running.
LanguageData.PGM_History_NotEnoughSamples: Only one sample has been recorded. At least two are needed to draw a trend.
LanguageData.PGM_History_Discarded: {0} stored samples were unreadable and were ignored.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_HistoryInfo: History is sampled every {0} and kept for {1} in-game days. Collections are bounded, so older samples are discarded. The retained samples currently span {2}.
LanguageData.PGM_Tab_DiagnosticsTip: Advisories generated from observed power data, with evidence and suggested actions.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_RestoreTip: Show advisories you dismissed earlier. Dismissals are remembered for the rest of this play session only.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_MutedCount: {0} advisory kind(s) are muted in the mod settings.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_MuteTip: Stop listing this kind of advisory. Saved with your settings.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_DismissTip: Hide this advisory until it is resolved, or until you restore hidden advisories.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_RowTip: Advisories are derived from observed power data only. They never change how the game distributes power.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Empty: No advisories. Nothing in the current power readings looks like a problem.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_EmptyFiltered: No advisory matches the current filter.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Disabled: Diagnostics are turned off in the mod settings. Monitoring and history still work.

LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Desc_NoGeneration: {0} consumer(s) are connected but nothing on this network is generating.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Desc_Isolated: This consumer has a power component but no network assignment, so it is not part of any electrical network.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Desc_Pending: The building's network membership could not be confirmed during the last reading. This usually settles on the next refresh.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Desc_Generator: Currently producing {0} against a configured {1}. It has stayed that low for {2}.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Desc_AboveConfig: Measured draw is {0} against a configured {1}.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Desc_OffDrawing: The flick switch is off, yet the building still reports a draw of {0}.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Desc_Unsupported: At least one power component is not a recognised type, so its electrical behaviour is not interpreted or counted.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Ev_Discharge: Charge {0}, stored {1} of {2}, estimated depletion in {3}, {4} supporting sample(s).
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Ev_NoGeneration: Consumers are asking for {0}; battery charge is {1}.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Ev_Isolated: Configured draw would be {0} if it were connected.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Ev_Pending: No reading in this snapshot confirms which network the building belongs to.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Ev_Generator: Observed on network {0} while the building is switched on.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Ev_AboveConfig: That is {0} above the configured draw.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Ev_OffDrawing: Configured draw is {0}; measured draw should be zero while switched off.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Ev_Unsupported: The component is listed so you can see it, but no number is taken from it.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Act_Deficit: Add about {0} of generation to this network, or switch off non-essential consumers on it.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Act_HighLoad: Generation still covers demand, so this is a warning rather than a fault. Consider extra generation before demand grows.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Act_Discharge: Close the {0} gap: add generation, or shed load before the batteries run out.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Act_NoGeneration: Connect a generator, or check that existing generators are switched on, fuelled and not broken down.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Act_Isolated: Connect the building to a powered network with cables or a conduit, or dismantle it if it is not needed.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Act_Pending: No action needed. If it persists across refreshes, the building likely uses a custom power system.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Act_Generator: Rule out the ordinary causes first: solar produces nothing at night and wind idles in calm weather. Then check fuel, breakdowns and the flick switch.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Act_AboveConfig: No action needed by itself. Variable consumers legitimately exceed their configured draw; it matters when sizing generation.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Act_OffDrawing: Usually a modded component that is not controlled by the vanilla switch. The reported draw is real, so it counts against your generation.
LanguageData.PGM_Diag_Act_Unsupported: No action needed. This is reported so you know the dashboard cannot fully account for that building.

LanguageData.PGM_Tab_ForecastTip: Battery endurance from the current balance and, when available, recorded history.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_NetTip: Trader balance {0} minus battery self-discharge {1}. This is the rate the estimate uses.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_RangeTip: History range used to support the estimate.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_NoBatteries: This map has no batteries, so there is no stored energy to forecast.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_NoCapacity: Battery capacity could not be read, so no forecast is produced.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_Depleted: No stored energy is left to draw on.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_Balanced: Generation and consumption are balanced, so no depletion or charge time is meaningful.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_Depleting: Batteries are draining. Estimated depletion in {0}.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_DepletingLong: Batteries are draining slowly. Depletion in more than {0}.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_Charging: Batteries are charging. Estimated full in {0}.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_ChargingLong: Batteries are charging slowly. Full in more than {0}.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_Basis_History: the current balance, supported by {0} samples over the {1}
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_Caveat: These are estimates from observed conditions, not measurements. Anything that changes demand or output changes the answer.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_NoHistory: At least {0} samples are needed before history can support the estimate. Samples are taken roughly every {1} while the map is running.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_NoNetworks: No network on this map has a battery.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_NetworkTip: Stored {0} of {1}. Per-network estimates use this network's current balance only.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_Notes: {0} {1} The forecast assumes the observed balance continues and that demand does not change. Vanilla batteries have no verified discharge rate limit, so no rate limit is applied; batteries that are disabled by EMP are excluded from the usable energy. Nothing here changes the game's power simulation.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_SelfDischargeOn: Self-discharge of {0} across {1} battery(ies) is subtracted, because the trader balance does not include it.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_SelfDischargeOff: Battery self-discharge is not included, so the depletion estimate is optimistic.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_EfficiencyKnown: Charging losses use the batteries' own efficiency; charge is {0}.
LanguageData.PGM_Forecast_EfficiencyUnknown: Charge efficiency could not be confirmed, so the charging estimate assumes no charging loss and is optimistic.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_Advisories: Warning and critical advisories from the diagnostics engine. Open the Diagnostics tab for evidence and suggested actions.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_Critical: Advisories rated critical: a deficit with no reserve, batteries close to empty, or a network with consumers and no generation.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_Endurance: Estimated time until the map's stored energy runs out, or until it is full, from the balance measured at the last refresh.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_EnduranceBasis: How much the endurance estimate can be trusted. It is Low when only the current balance is known, High when recorded history agrees with it.
LanguageData.PGM_Tip_NetworkEndurance: Estimated from this network's current balance only. The Forecast tab uses recorded history as well.
LanguageData.PGM_Settings_ForecastNote: Endurance estimates combine the current balance with recorded history. Self-discharge is a verified 5 W per battery that the trader balance does not include.
LanguageData.PGM_DiagnosticsEnabled_Tip: Analyse the power readings for deficits, high load, draining batteries and connectivity problems. Monitoring and history keep working when this is off.
LanguageData.PGM_ShowInfoDiagnostics_Tip: Include advisories that are worth knowing but are not faults, such as unconfirmed network membership or a draw above the configured amount.
LanguageData.PGM_ShowPowerMessages_Tip: Show the game's own message when a new warning or critical advisory appears. Rate limited, and the full list is always on the Diagnostics tab.
LanguageData.PGM_DeficitAlert_Tip: Smaller shortfalls are ignored. Raise this on a busy map to cut noise, lower it to catch small problems.
LanguageData.PGM_LowBattery_Tip: A draining network becomes a critical advisory once its charge falls to this level.
LanguageData.PGM_PersistentDeficit_Tip: How long a deficit or high load must continue before it is escalated.
LanguageData.PGM_GeneratorIdle_Tip: How long a generator must stay far below its configured output before it is reported. Keep this long if you use solar or wind: they idle legitimately.
LanguageData.PGM_AlertCooldown_Tip: Minimum gap between announcements, up to two at a time. A condition that returns within this window counts as the same episode, so it is not announced again.
LanguageData.PGM_SelfDischarge_Tip: Subtract the game's verified 5 W per battery self-discharge from the endurance estimate. The trader balance does not include it.
